info.name: aiDigiPlanner API
info.description:
Full backend API for aiDigiPlanner: registration/onboarding, company & brand setup, products & sub-products, social accounts, team invites, AI creative generation, and content review/approval/scheduling.

How to use:
1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. Open the collection's Variables tab and set `base_url` (defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8000) if your server runs elsewhere.
3. Run **Auth > Register**. This auto-saves `company_id`.
4. Check your backend console/logs for the emailed 6-digit verification code (ConsoleEmailService logs it when SMTP isn't configured), paste it into the `otp` variable, then run **Auth > Verify Email**.
5. Note: a brand-new company is `pending_approval` until a Super Admin approves it (see the Admin folder) -- login is blocked until then, unless you're testing against a dev DB where you flip the company's status directly.
6. Run **Auth > Login**. This auto-saves `access_token` / `refresh_token`, which every other request uses via the collection's Bearer auth.
7. Work through the folders top to bottom -- most "create" requests auto-save the id they return (see each request's description) into the collection variable the next requests need.

For Admin-folder requests, log in as a Super Admin account instead (create one via `uv run python scripts/seed_super_admin.py` on the server) -- Super Admins have no company, so re-run Login with that account's credentials before using the Admin folder, then Login again with a normal admin account to continue elsewhere.

Fill manually from a Company Members list response's user_id, for Add Product Member
Fill manually from a concept detail response's assets[].id

request.description:
Creates the user + a DRAFT/pending_approval company (COMPANY_ADMIN role), and emails a 6-digit verification code.

Fields:
- password: min 10 characters.
- Auto-saves `company_id` from the response.
Confirms the 6-digit code emailed at registration. `otp` must be exactly 6 digits.
Re-sends a fresh verification code. Always returns the same generic message, whether or not the email exists (no account enumeration).
Auto-saves `access_token` / `refresh_token`. Fails with 403 if the email isn't verified yet, or the company is pending_approval/rejected/suspended.
Rotates the refresh token (old one is revoked). Auto-saves the new pair.
Revokes just this one refresh token/session.
Revokes every session for the current user (bumps token_version).
The current user's profile plus every company/product membership -- useful for grabbing ids while testing.
Emails a separate 6-digit password-reset code (different from the email-verification one).
Consumes the forgot-password code, auto-saves `reset_token` for Reset Password.
new_password: min 10 characters. Revokes all existing sessions.
Requires the current password. new_password: min 10 characters. Revokes all existing sessions -- you'll need to log in again.

brand_structure options: single_brand | multi_brand | unsure.

Company Admin only.
Phase 4A (single_brand path). Sets the industry dropdown value onto the company-level brand profile. Company Admin only.
Phase 4B (multi_brand path). Both fields optional. Company Admin only.
multipart/form-data, field name `file`. Accepts image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp. Company Admin only.
onboarding_step values: registered | email_verified | brand_structure_selected | brand_profile_completed | first_product_created | completed.
Marks onboarding_step = completed (Phase 12's "workspace ready" action, after sub-products/social/team are done or skipped). Company Admin only.

role options: company_admin | member.

`full_name` is only required if the email doesn't match an existing user -- a new account is created and emailed generated credentials. Company Admin only. Auto-saves `member_id`.
role options: company_admin | member. status options: active | suspended. Both fields optional. Company Admin only.
Company Admin only. Cannot remove the last active company_admin.

request.description: Same shape as the product-scope upsert (only the required fields are shown here for brevity) -- only meaningful when the sub-product's branding_mode is separate_brand.

Phase 5. Provide EITHER website_url OR description (at least one required). Set dry_run=false to use the real Gemini API (needs GEMINI_API_KEY configured server-side and costs money) -- leave it true to use the free deterministic mock. Company Admin only.

approval_policy options (Phase 20): no_approval | one_approver | product_manager_approval | company_admin_approval.

Product Manager (or Company Admin) only.
Phase 13 cards: drafts, pending_approvals, scheduled, published, failed_jobs, social_accounts_total/active.

role options: creator | approver | publisher | analyst | product_manager. Requires the user already be a company member (use Company Members > Add first, or Invite Product Member below to do both in one step). sub_product_ids empty = all sub-products. Product Manager (or Company Admin) only.

Phase 11. role options: creator | approver | publisher | analyst | product_manager. Creates the User (if new, emails generated credentials) and the CompanyMember (if needed) in the same call as the ProductMember. sub_product_ids empty = all sub-products. Product Manager (or Company Admin) only.

Phase 9's quick-add -- names only, one or many in one call. Each inherits the parent product's branding (branding_mode=use_product_branding) until changed. Product Manager (or Company Admin) only. Auto-saves the first created sub-product's id.
All fields optional. status options: active | archived. branding_mode options: use_product_branding | separate_brand. Product Manager (or Company Admin) only.

request.description:
product_line must match a `product_lines[].id` on the resolved brand profile.
format options: post | carousel | reel (carousel_slides required 3-8 for carousel; reel_duration_s 8-30s + voiceover + reel_style for reel).
language options: en | hi | hinglish.
quality options: draft | standard | hero.
voiceover options (reel only): native_audio | silent_text.
reel_style options (reel only): story | avatar (avatar needs a product avatar image uploaded first).
platforms items: instagram | facebook | youtube | google | twitter | linkedin.
force=true bypasses the identical-brief idempotency check.
dry_run=true uses the free mock AI provider (real generation needs GEMINI_API_KEY configured server-side and costs money).

Returns 202 with a GenerationJob. Auto-saves `job_id`.
status options: queued | running | awaiting_render | succeeded | failed | partially_failed. Poll this until it's terminal.
Only valid when the job's status is awaiting_render (reel-format jobs pause here after ideation). 400s for a post/carousel job or a second call on the same job.

query.description: Optional -- filter to one generation job
Optional. Options: draft | in_review | approved | rejected | scheduled | published

request.description: Auto-saves `concept_id` from the first result.
assets[] in the response carries each rendered image/video's `id` -- copy one into `asset_id` to try the download request below.
draft -> in_review.
-> approved. Enforced against the product's approval_policy (see Update Product) -- a Company Admin always has authority regardless of policy.
-> rejected, and files `reason` as a comment on the concept too. Same approval_policy enforcement as Approve.
Only valid from status=approved -> scheduled. scheduled_at is an ISO-8601 datetime; this only records intent -- nothing auto-publishes at that time.
Valid from approved or scheduled -> published. Records status/published_at only -- does not call out to any social platform (manual-entry social accounts, no OAuth).
Phase 20: draft/in_review -> published in one call. Still subject to approval_policy unless the actor is a Company Admin.
Fill `asset_id` from a Get Creative Concept response's assets[].id first.
